errors.description: The drawing is a symmetric front elevation. The render is the same oblique three-quarter flat-lay staging used for collar-fashion-point-58, with only the image-left leaf legible and the image-right leaf running away from camera into heavy foreshortening at the frame edge.
errors.expected: Front elevation with both collar leaves presented at equal scale
errors.actual: Oblique staging; one leaf legible, the other collapsed
errors.correction: Shoot square-on from directly in front at collar height with the placket vertical and centred, so both squared leaves render at equal scale and can be compared.

errors.description: The blueprint prints an 80.00-degree spread with leader lines to both tips, and both tips were located at (78,140) and (134,140.5), separation 56px - the widest of the five drawings. The oblique render makes the included angle unmeasurable, so the annotated dimension is not communicated at all.
errors.expected: A readable 80-degree included angle, visibly wider than the 60-degree fashion-point sibling
errors.actual: Spread angle not measurable from this viewpoint
errors.correction: Lay both collar leaves flat and symmetric with the collar closed, so the included angle between them reads clearly as a moderately wide 80 degrees.

errors.description: Visually interchangeable with the candidates for collar-fashion-point-58 and collar-regular-20. Three menu entries, three photographs a customer cannot tell apart.
errors.expected: A photograph immediately distinguishable from its four menu siblings by squared tips and 80-degree spread
errors.actual: Generic angled shirt photo duplicating two siblings
errors.correction: Compose so the squared tips and the wide 80-degree spread are the dominant read, with the collar filling the frame and both leaves symmetric.

errors.description: The visible leaf terminates at roughly (375,812) in what reads as a soft blunt point rather than a crisp squared terminal edge. The blueprint's tip closes over about 2px from a 5px width at y=138, which at 229px resolution cannot definitively be called square versus point, but the label, description and spec forbidden list all call for a flat squared edge and the render does not read as squared.
errors.expected: A flat squared-off terminal edge on each collar leaf
errors.actual: Soft rounded-off point on the one legible leaf; the second leaf's tip is not resolvable
errors.correction: Terminate each collar leaf in a short flat horizontal cut edge with two crisp right-angle corners, so the end face is a visible straight segment rather than a taper.

errors.description: The blueprint shows the leaves crossing over a fastened throat button. The render shows the collar open with the leaves apart; a faint circular form near (615,610) may be a band button or buttonhole but is ambiguous and not clearly fastened.
errors.expected: Collar leaves crossing at a closed throat button, band fastened
errors.actual: Collar presented open; throat closure ambiguous
errors.correction: Fasten the top band button so the leaves converge and cross at the throat as drawn, with the button clearly visible at the crossing.

lockedFeatures: No necktie; nothing covers the collar band or the spread
No traced annotation across a 256,960-pixel sample
White crisp cotton poplin with clean parallel edge topstitching
Neutral background and soft directional lighting
Collar band roll and stand visible and correctly proportioned on the legible side
notes: Same failure mode and same staging batch as collar-fashion-point-58. Measurable on the drawing: printed 80.00 degrees; tips at (78,140) and (134,140.5) giving 56px separation, the widest of the five, against 36.5px for the 60-degree fashion point - a coherent cross-check on the drawings themselves. NOT measurable: tip squareness at 229x244 is genuinely borderline, since the leaf narrows from 5px to 1px over 2px of drop, so shape was graded on the render not reading as squared rather than claiming the drawing proves an exact terminal width.
